correctness.rationale: The six cases exhaust all fourteen affine-group subgroups up to conjugacy, as proved by the normal translation subgroup argument and confirmed by exhaustive generation. A direct supported-cell face relation yields 10/30/15 cubical cells and 55/180/120 barycentric flags. A standalone exact integer enumerator computes every orbit, checks counts again by Burnside, verifies each quotient vertex has a single circle or interval link, determines connected boundary and orientation-sign consistency, and obtains the six surface types by Euler-characteristic classification. The continuous homotopy claims additionally use an explicit group-equivariant two-particle deformation retraction. Crucially, homeomorphism is asserted only for compact D/H, not noncompact X/H.

value.rationale: The complete six-class subgroup lattice of the natural affine transitive group has a substantive and unanticipated surface-type progression: nonorientable genera seven and three, punctured Klein bottle, Moebius band and disk. It distinguishes two quotients with the same rational first Betti number by integral torsion and boundary behavior, and identifies two distinct mechanisms of contractible quotient. It is a natural complete classification under the canonical five-point affine group, not a parameter-tuned isolated orbit count or a restatement of S5/A5 cases.
